_about: Hand-kept corrections to the capitals and towns on the maps (Plan 14 section 6). build/tools/makemaps.py reads this when it writes docs/assets/maps/<country>.json, so run it again after editing. For each country id: 'rename' maps a Natural Earth name to the name shown, 'remove' lists names to drop, and 'add' lists places Natural Earth lacks (n, lat, lon, pop, and cap: true for the capital of its province or state).
